narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no pauses between sentences.

luna.instruct: Carefree, sunny, brutally honest young woman, laughing, fast and breezy.

agent.instruct: Calm, flat, professional airport gate agent, short and matter of fact.

maya.instruct: Happy, surprised friend at a party, bright and fast.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your Sagittarius friend booked a flight to Peru mid-brunch.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She did it mid-sentence with syrup all over her phone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meet Luna who is fun and free and dangerously honest.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Your bangs were a mistake babe but I love you!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bea touches her bangs while Luna is already ordering pancakes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her suitcase is always packed and she sleeps in hiking boots.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She has seen thirty countries and zero dentists.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her friends throw her a goodbye party and everyone cries.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luna waves from the gate and she has never been happier.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the gate agent holds out her hand.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Passport, please.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luna checks her pockets and her bag and her boots.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her passport is at home in the freezer next to the peas.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So what's going on inside a Sagittarius?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a room where every door says EXIT.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There's a compass on the wall but north is missing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A bow and arrow labelled TRUTH is aimed right at your bangs.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And a calendar marked PLANS is completely blank.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luna takes the bus home and the party is still going.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You're back? We still have cake!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everyone cheers and Luna eats half the cake.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That night she books a flight to Iceland.
